findings.issue: Hosted zone force deletion can be enabled
findings.risk: Setting force_destroy to true can allow deletion of the hosted zone and all associated records, which can cause denial of service, domain hijacking opportunities, and loss of critical DNS configurations.
findings.remediation: Set the force_destroy attribute to false in the aws_route53_zone.this resource: force_destroy = false.

findings.issue: Hosted zone force deletion can be enabled
findings.risk: Setting force_destroy to true can allow deletion of the hosted zone and all associated records, which can cause denial of service, domain hijacking opportunities, and loss of critical DNS configurations.
findings.remediation: Set the force_destroy attribute to false in the aws_route53_zone.ignore_vpc resource: force_destroy = false.

findings.issue: KMS key rotation is disabled for DNSSEC key
findings.risk: Disabling KMS key rotation increases the impact of long-term key compromise and weakens cryptographic hygiene by keeping the same key material in use indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Change the enable_key_rotation attribute in module.route53_dnssec_kms to true: enable_key_rotation = true.

findings.issue: DNS record overwrite may be allowed
findings.risk: If allow_overwrite is true, existing DNS records can be replaced unintentionally or maliciously, potentially redirecting traffic, disrupting services, or enabling subdomain takeover scenarios.
findings.remediation: Set allow_overwrite to false for records in aws_route53_record.this, or constrain the input so each.value.allow_overwrite resolves to false.
